playstyle.identity: Volibear is a diving juggernaut who disables towers with his ultimate. He excels at tower diving and becomes an unstoppable force in teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives attack speed stacks that chain lightning. Q gives speed and stuns on next auto. W bites and heals (more damage if used twice quickly). E creates a shield zone from the sky. R leaps and disables towers, gaining size and HP. Tower dive with impunity.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Volibear spikes at level 6 with tower disabling. Trinity Force or tank items work. He's strong at diving and teamfighting.

weaknesses: W needs 2 hits for full effect

passive.name: The Relentless Storm
passive.summary: Attacks grant stacking attack speed; at max stacks, lightning chains.
passive.details: Volibear's attacks grant attack speed stacks. At max stacks, his attacks chain lightning to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Thundering Smash
abilities.summary: Gain speed toward enemies; next attack stuns and deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Volibear gains movement speed toward enemies. His next auto attack deals bonus damage and stuns the target.

abilities.name: Frenzied Maul
abilities.summary: Bite an enemy; heal if used twice quickly on same target.
abilities.details: Volibear mauls a target, dealing damage. If he hits the same target again within a few seconds, he deals bonus damage and heals.

abilities.name: Sky Splitter
abilities.summary: Call lightning that shields you and damages enemies in the zone.
abilities.details: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location. If he's inside when it strikes, he gains a shield. Enemies in the zone take damage.

abilities.name: Stormbringer
abilities.summary: Leap and crash down, disabling towers and gaining HP and size.
abilities.details: Volibear leaps to a location, gaining bonus health and size. On landing, he damages enemies and disables nearby enemy towers for several seconds.
